name: Recurring shoreline clean-ups
summary: Join community shoreline and shallow-water clean-ups coordinated by Moalboal's freediving community when dates are announced.
schedule: Reported as a recurring community activity; contact locally for the next confirmed date.
howToHelp: Confirm the next event with the association or a participating freediving centre
Join the shore team unless qualified and assigned to water work
Bring sun protection, water and reusable gloves if requested
